contentBlocks.body: EF Core performance issues often come from loading too much data, missing indexes, N+1 queries, or tracking entities that only need to be read. A strong answer starts with measurement before changing code.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Which change usually helps read-only EF Core queries?

choices: Use AsNoTracking when you do not update the entities
Load every column just in case
payload.answer: Use AsNoTracking when you do not update the entities
payload.explanation: AsNoTracking avoids change-tracking overhead for read-only projections.
